title: Stateful Icon: Checkbox state
description: Toggle Show details in the field, dropdown, menubar, or context menu. They share the same state and draw-on checkmark when checked. Toggle it off and on again to replay the animation. Mixed selection uses the shared minus mark. Reduced-motion preferences remove both transitions.
